locator: I q.75 a.2 co., Relinquitur igitur, with ad 1–2
interpretation: The designated intellectual principle does not inhere as an accident or material form. It may still be a part of human nature; no complete person or immortality is concluded. Read within q.76 a.1: the human being understands through the soul as its form; operation attribution does not identify the soul with the complete human being.
